d: Grand equatorial constellation dividing Serpens, home to Barnard’s Star and major nearby binary systems.

hip-86032.x: Brightest star in Ophiuchus (48.6 ly), a rapid rotator marking the head of the Serpent Bearer.

gaia-4472832130942575872.x: Nearest solitary star to the Sun (5.96 ly), displaying the highest known proper motion across Earth’s sky (10.3 arcsec/yr).

hip-84012.x: Binary star system consisting of two white A-type stars in an eccentric orbit.

gaia-4468557611984384512.x: Benchmark binary system of two orange K-type dwarfs (16.6 ly) in an 88-year mutual orbit.

gaia-4330690742322011520.x: Inactive red dwarf star (14.0 ly) harboring a multi-planet system including potentially habitable world Wolf 1061 c.

gaia-4473334474604992384.x: Orange giant star marking the right shoulder of the Serpent Bearer.

gaia-4357027756659697664.x: Red giant star forming the western hand of Ophiuchus clutching the serpent.

gaia-4356298849169862784.x: Yellow giant optical companion to Yed Prior in the hand of the Serpent Bearer.
